create_new_skill: create a new skill with name, description, content, and access grants using Skills.insert_new_skill
search_skills: search skills by query text with pagination using Skills.search_skills with filter and skip parameters
update_skill: update an existing skill by id with new fields using Skills.update_skill_by_id
toggle_skill_active: toggle a skill active or inactive state by id using Skills.toggle_skill_by_id
delete_skill: delete a skill by id and revoke all access grants using Skills.delete_skill_by_id
